title: OpenStax Algebra and Trigonometry 2e, 13.4 Series and Their Notations: Use summation notation.
summary: OpenStax Algebra and Trigonometry 2e, 13.4 Series and Their Notations: Use summation notation.
body: OpenStax Algebra and Trigonometry 2e, section "13.4 Series and Their Notations", prints these objectives: "Use summation notation." "Use the formula for the sum of the ﬁrst n terms of an arithmetic series." "Use the formula for the sum of the ﬁrst n terms of a geometric series." "Use the formula for the sum of an inﬁnite geometric series." "Solve annuity problems.". The section text says: "A parent decides to start a college fund for their daughter. They plan to invest $50 in the fund each month. The fund pays 6% annual interest, compounded monthly. How much money will they have saved when their daughter is ready to start college in 6 years? In this section, we will learn how to answer this question. To do so, we need to consider the amount of money invested and the amount of interest earned." This card reports that page. The objectives are the book's learning statements, not a separate proof.
